method: A pick is kept only if (1) the fixture and kick-off are confirmed and do not conflict between sources, (2) team news for the picked team's own attack was found in at least two sources and does not point the other way, and (3) the goal model probability clears the threshold. Probabilities come from team_goal_picks.py. Sports4Cast's own accuracy record could not be verified, so its numbers are one input, not proof.
